house.description: Eligibility for the Dairy Assistance, Investment, Relief Initiative (DAIRI) program modified.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Agriculture Finance and Policy
Committee report, to adopt and re-refer to Ways and Means
See Senate file in House SF3832

latest_action.text: See Senate file in House SF3832

additions: New dairy farms that did not market milk during 2022 or for only a portion of 2022 are eligible.

For new dairy farms that did not market milk during 2022 or for only a portion of 2022, the commissioner must make DAIRI payments based on the farm's production history as established in its dairy risk protection program enrollment.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
